answer: Give every new identity a narrow ledge to stand on: capped rewards and no referrals until it has completed verified work across many epochs. Rights harden like marble curing - a ferrous time-anchor chains each epoch's work record to the last, so history cannot be bought or transferred; selling an account resets its clock to zero. A sybil farm can mint a thousand names, but each one must pay weeks of genuine, sequential work before it earns anything, and the time cost is the same for every clone. Time is the one resource that cannot be parallelized.
